data.title: Add Playwright end-to-end tests against the running compose stack

data.to:
Add Playwright end-to-end tests that exercise the real running stack (docker compose: web + Postgres + token auth) from the outside, verifying PROMPT.md behavior works in the actual app rather than only in Django's test client. Requested directly by Forrest.

Context: unit/integration coverage already exists (12 APITestCase tests in app/telemetry/tests.py, run against Postgres). These e2e tests are the 'does the deployed stack actually work' layer: real HTTP against the compose web service, real token auth, real Postgres.

Decisions to be made in planning: Python playwright (pytest-playwright) vs Node — the repo is Python-only, so prefer Python unless a strong reason emerges; Playwright's APIRequestContext is the right tool since this is a JSON API with no browser UI (admin UI smoke test optional). Test setup must provision a user + token non-interactively (e.g. docker compose exec web manage.py shell -c ... or a management command) and must clean up or use unique devEUIs per run so tests are re-runnable against a persistent DB.

Scope: e2e test suite, any tiny helpers needed for non-interactive token provisioning, README section on running them, and whatever dependency/config files the chosen runner needs. Tests must cover at minimum: happy-path ingest of the PROMPT.md example (201, passing), duplicate fCnt → 409, failing value (AA==), unauthenticated → 401, and that Device.latest_status flips (observable via a second payload or the admin/DB).

Convention reminder: commit .lattice/ changes along with the work (see CLAUDE.md).

data.body: Implemented per plan: e2e/requirements.txt (playwright==1.61.0, pytest==9.1.1), e2e/conftest.py (base_url/playwright/api/anon_api/fresh_dev_eui fixtures, autouse session reachability check with pytest.exit compose hint, compose-exec token provisioning with E2E_TOKEN override, get_device_status helper), e2e/test_ingest.py (8 tests), README 'End-to-end tests' section. Verified: pytest e2e/ -v = 8/8 passing, immediate re-run 8/8 (re-runnable, fresh uuid EUIs, no cleanup); with web stopped the suite exits fast with the 'API not reachable ... docker compose up -d' message; git diff under app/ empty. Deps installed into the mise .venv. Commit 8391593 (includes .lattice + pending CLAUDE.md convention edit per new convention). One deviation from plan letter: manage_shell raises RuntimeError (caught + pytest.exit in auth_token) so a mid-test compose failure fails that test with stderr instead of aborting the session.

REVIEW (cold, independent): PASS. Verified: (1) commit 8391593 and working tree touch nothing under app/ — image contents unchanged; (2) pip install -r e2e/requirements.txt clean on venv Python 3.14.6, no playwright install step; (3) pytest e2e/ -v = 8/8 passed, run twice back-to-back plus a third run after a web restart — re-runnable against persistent DB with no cleanup; (4) fail-fast: with web stopped, suite exits immediately with 'API not reachable at http://localhost:8000. Start the stack first: docker compose up -d && ...' — no hang, no traceback; (5) assertions pin real behavior: exact 201 camelCase shape incl. receivedAt '2022-07-19T11:00:00Z' and decodedHex, exact 409 detail string, exact 400 body {'data': ['Not valid base64.']}, fCnt bigint regression pin from HDT-7; (6) latest_status flip asserted against real Postgres via docker compose exec Django shell, not just response bodies; (7) fresh_dev_eui is function-scoped uuid4 hex — unique per test, no collisions, no leaked state; compose-exec snippets passed as argv (no shell=True), interpolated EUI is fixture hex — no injection surface; (8) E2E_BASE_URL/E2E_TOKEN overrides sound; README section accurate and followable; CLAUDE.md paragraph matches Forrest's stated commit-.lattice-with-the-work convention. Minor non-blocking notes: get_device_status still requires compose exec even when E2E_TOKEN points at a remote stack (inherent to the chosen DB-assertion mechanism, acknowledged in plan); other_dev_eui = reversed hex has a theoretical palindrome collision (~16^-8, ignorable). Environmental note (pre-existing, not HDT-8): plain 'docker compose up -d' without mise env active hits the amd64/arm64 platform mismatch from .env's DOCKER_DEFAULT_PLATFORM=linux/amd64; DOCKER_DEFAULT_PLATFORM=linux/arm64 per mise.local.toml resolves it. Verdict: meets all 6 acceptance criteria — done.
